changelog: Trailers no longer need the local server to be running: when the server cannot bind, the same trailer page is loaded straight into the player
A dead trailer server is now rebuilt and retried once instead of leaving a black screen
Trailer / YouTube pages route to the web player instead of ExoPlayer, which retried an HTML page forever and looked like endless buffering
Trailer server keeps its listening socket alive instead of handing out a stale port nobody accepts on
